_readme: Players who have been TRADED AWAY from the Yankees organization -- excluded entirely from every leaderboard and every category, regardless of level. This is DIFFERENT from config/excluded_players.json (which filters established MLB veterans out of a 'prospects only' view): being on THIS list means the player simply isn't part of the Yankees organization anymore at all, even though he was earlier this season and his games while a Yankee are still real. Keyed by MLB Stats API person ID. IDs below were cross-referenced from MLB.com/MiLB.com player pages and Baseball America's trade deadline coverage, not guessed. Review this file at each trade deadline and whenever a name looks unfamiliar on a leaderboard -- that's often a sign someone left the org.
